senses.gloss:
Apheggupaṭho
Bud. Pāli. Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 36. fn. 2.

Apheggusāra
Bud. Pāli. on topics of Abhidharma; written in the 14th cent. by a scholar of Haṁsavatī in Burma.
Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 36 an. fn. 2. Sāsanavamsa 48.

Apheggusāratthadīpanī
Bud. Pāli. Cabaton II. p. 645.

Apheggusāradīpanī
Bud. Pāli. probably by Mahāsuvaṇṇadīpa, teacher of queen Sīvalī; composed a. Haṁsavatī in Burma. Fausboll p. 39.
In Nevill's Cat. of Mss. in the Br. Mus., this work is described a. a. Aṇuṭīkā dealing with matter in the Abhidhammatthavibhāvanī. Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 36, fn. 2.

Apheggusāradīpanīpaṭho
Bud. Pāli. Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 36. fn. 2.
